hypothesis: Reinvesting the four exact padding bytes removed from every A10 cell into deterministic dense range capacity adds 1,215,436 cells under the unchanged per-table payload budgets and saves at least 2,000 bytes per million on opening and distant exact gates.
interfaces_exposed: A10 ContextMap2 record layout, table cardinality, and deterministic range index
kill_condition: Retire this realization on exact reconstruction or determinism failure, decimal-10GB RSS failure, non-positive opening 1M gain, canonical 10M gain below 23KB, or non-positive distant transfer. Do not tune budget bytes, scrambler constants, or table subsets.
promotion_condition: Pass exact 250K roundtrip, determinism, and decimal-10GB RSS; then save at least 2,000 B/M on opening 1M, at least 23KB on canonical 10M, and remain positive on a frozen distant gate.

title: Budget-preserving tight-cell capacity expansion
